mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) signals strong housing market demand, which correlates with elevated consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle recovery phases, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises above its 12-month moving average during early-cycle recovery.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it indicates an exceptionally tight labor market that fuels wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust demand for housing, which correlates with strong consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST increases fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: After an inflation peak (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a decline in the federal funds rate signals a shift to monetary easing, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines after CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.
